scientific_integrity: Claims of exact infinite-family validity follow from the supplied combinatorial proof. The finite checker is corroborating evidence, not a certification of all cases. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the increasing-integer coordinate order of first-order binary Reed–Muller codes, not arbitrary permutations or higher order. Computations check dimensions through eight; the proof treats all positive dimensions.
title: Complete joint cyclic window-weight profiles of lexicographic first-order Reed–Muller codes
